About Local 820

ATU Local 820 represents NJ Transit bus workers in Union City and Hudson County. The local negotiates and enforces the contract, stands with members in discipline and grievances, and sends delegates to the ATU New Jersey State Council. Officer names, garages and hall details below are placeholders until the local confirms them.
